book.name: Emi iRoma
book.title: Afɛ mgbi iPol mbiama onoyɛyɛ Emi iRoma

content: Imgbasho sadu emi Israi
N le gbɔ otsitsi mbi iKrestu, n le mwonya ba, itukwu mgbɛn kpaa nin obube ba, Onodzi Osaan li obwɛndɛ mgbɛn,
Eka kwowina len kpakpa itukwu di wulin jo dondu ba.
Bana n mina gbɛɛ ani abuen a ki wo ani ikamba di dzabɔ yi iKrestu mi ikye emi ongwunani, emi Israi ama nli etɔ yi ani nɛni.

A li emidi Imgbasho ngwu Imgbasho kyelu ma nu ma yɛɛ etɔ mgban. Imgbasho tso ma okwɔkwɔ mgban. O bwondu yi ama di kye ola mgban nu ma. Ozu osunu Imgbasho mi iJerosalin na bɛyi ondu Imgbasho dzɛ duu li mgbi ama.
Li ama li inyabyi, di li mboma ngwi iKrestu tɔ etɔ mi ɛsɛ nɛni, ongwu nli Imgbasho onghaangha nɛni. Nu ma tsan gyegwu! No dzɛ ngha.
No ka dzɛ dafi elodzimgbasho wɛɛsɛ ba. Lubana li ama ntɔ etɔ mi Israi duu li emi Israi yɛyɛ ba.
Dafi etɔ mgbi Abrahan tsatsa li emi ongwiba mgbi Abrahan ba nɛni. Imgbasho nya Abrahan gbɛɛ, <<Li ikpewo Adziki ngwi abu ka tu etɔ ngwi Ani zondu yi abu nani.>>
Ungwɔnɛ tso gbɛɛ, li engwɛ ama Abrahan mba abɔn li emi ongwɛ Imgbasho kyɛmɛ-kyɛmɛ ba, kpaa li engwɛ ama Abrahan mba mi ondu odzɛɛdzɛ ma ngwu a kye ma wuuta gbɛɛ engwiba mgbi Abrahan aali.
Lubana li ela mgbi ondu odzɛɛdzɛ ma aani: <<Onova nkyɛ nɛ mi itɔ onɔ nɛ yɛyɛ n ka yidɔ, iSara ka byi ongwɛ abɔ.>>
Li nana ta ba, ongwefa mgbi iRebeka ntona a sulu otsɔma onyi, otsikyeyi Adziki.

Nghaduu, duuse ni a mba engwefa ntona, naadi nu ma wa kyɔ obube hona osuse yɔ, Imgbasho nya iRebeka gbɛɛ ongwan ongwu okwukwo na kale kyɔ ongwu ongbungbɛ idɔ. Imgbasho gbɔdzɛ nɛ ikye otso gbɛɛ ongwu dulu ongwi itukwu ongwu wa, ma yama li ikye unkoka ngwi a kyɔ ba,
li mi idɔ okyɔɔkyɔ ba, kpaa li mbi Imgbasho ongwu nkwu ela mani, a nyan gbɛɛ, <<Okwukwo na kale kyɔ ongwu ongbungbɛ idɔ.>>
Yɛyɛ dafi Afɛ lɔ mani gbɛɛ, <<iJeko kpɛn itukwu, kpaa Isol tɛn anyi.>>
Nghanɛ i ka gbɔn sinɛ tso? Imgbasho kyɔ ebɛbɛ? Ngha ba dududu!
Lubana o gbɔ nya iMose gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ ngwu ani mina n ka dun elela, inggisɛ ngwu ani di mina n ka kyɔ elela won.>>
Nghanɛ, ungwɔ ndzɛ mbisɔ gbɛɛ ka dzɛ yɔ, li imina hona ofyaafya mgbi inggisɛ ba, kpaa li elela odiidi mgbi Imgbasho.
Li ngha ma ngwi Imgbasho gbɔ nya iFaro mi Afɛ gbɛɛ, <<Li mi itɔdzɛ nɛ yɛyɛ ngwi ani kyile abu desho, gbɛɛ nin tso mfye mgbɛn mboo, adzi ni a gbɔdzɛn kpatsɛ ɛsɛ duu.>>
Nghanɛ Imgbasho sulu elela odiidi mbi inggisɛ ngwu i kpan odin elela mani, o di li kye ali inggisɛ ngwu i kpan duu itukwu tiishu.
Inggisɛ oka mbi ema ka byi ani gbɛɛ: <<Nɛ kyɔnɛ ngwi Imgbasho di li nu eyi obube? Lubana li emɛ ka kyi ndɛlu owitukwu mgbi Imgbasho?>>
Ei, ka gbɔ ngha ba. Abu li emɛ, inggisɛ owamyɛ hini, ka tangwɛ yi Imgbasho? Ungwɔ ngwi a ta-ta ka yagba nya Ongwu ntan ma gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔnɛ abu ta ani dzɛ ngha gbɛɛ?>>
Ongye ombɛ ishe sulu ofɛ okye akwiibɛ onyi ma mbɛ ishe ama a ka kyungwɔ ingblimɔ di mbɛ angbeka ngwi a ka kyungwɔ imɔ mi ele ba gbɛ lo?
Kabana Imgbasho mina otso itingga yi mfye mgban mbi ali inggisɛ ngwu o mina odzilin duu, nghaduu o shitukwu yi ama.
Kaba o kyungwɔnɛ ikye otso okwɔkwɔ mgbi ongwu mi onɔ ngwi ongwu dzɛ yi elela odiidi mbi ama ongwu kyi mɛlu ma tokɛ gbɛɛ ni a tu okwɔkwɔ mgbi ongwu mani.
Eyi kpaa wodzɛ mbi ama ngwu o sadu mani, li emi iJuda ta ba, Udzengye kpaa.
Dafi Otsɛ gbɔ yɛyɛ mi afɛ mgbi iHosia mani gbɛɛ:

content.text: ba kpaa n ka kwu ma gbɛɛ, <Emidɛn>;
n ka tso okpitukwu mbi inggisɛ
tso okpitukwu yi ama ye ba mani.
<<Imbe ngwi a plɛ nya ma gbɛɛ,
li mi ele yɛyɛ ngwi a

content: Ongye ogbɛɛsɛ Adzaya gbobakwɔ ikye emi Israi gbɛɛ:

content.text: nɛ kpaa, li gwee ni ta ka watɔ.
o gbɔgbɛɛ ongwu ka kyɔ ma yɛyɛ.>>

content: Dzɛ yɛyɛ dafi Adzaya tsekise gbɔ mani gbɛɛ:

content.text: <<Ni Otsɛ Ongha yi mfye ki dzata etɔ mgbi eyi
eyi kika dzili dafi iSodon yi iGomora mani.>>

content: Emi Israi noyɛyɛ ba
Ni i gbɔn sinɛ tsatso? Udzengye ama ngbli mi odzɛ osaan ba kpaa, tun mi oyɛyɛ onuunu.
Kpaa emi Israi ama ngbli gbɛɛ ama ki dzɛ osaan yi Imgbasho ma kpaa tun ba.
Kyɔnɛ ngwi a tu ba? Ikyekyɛ a pita li mi oyɛyɛ onuunu ba, kpaa a pita dafi li mi idɔ mgbi ama okyɔɔkyɔ mani. Ali nɛ yɛɛ iKrestu ngwi inggisɛ le tsiishi mi ele.
Dafi a lɔ mani gbɛɛ, <<Dika, n kye iKrestu la emi iDzayɔn nu ma le tsiishi bɛyi ikwutsɛ nnu ma le gbɛsɛ mani, nghaduu inggisɛ nnun oyɛyɛ yɔ, ka gyayiwi ba.>>
